# FR Skills

Load only the skills relevant to the current research question.

| Skill | File | When to load |
|---|---|---|
| Data Storytelling | `data-storytelling.md` | Turning evidence into a decision memo, review, or presentation |
| Evidence Gathering | `evidence-gathering.md` | Collecting reproducible evidence with provenance and appropriate handling |
| Evaluation Lifecycle | `eval-lifecycle.md` | Building, calibrating, releasing, or maintaining an evaluation system |
| Experimental Design | `experimental-design.md` | Estimating causal effects through controlled or quasi-experimental studies |
| Learning Science | `learning-science.md` | Designing instruction, practice, feedback, assessment, or mastery criteria |
| Live Debugging | `live-debugging.md` | Investigating a failure under time pressure with a stakeholder present |
| Math Verification | `math-verification.md` | Checking arithmetic, statistics, units, thresholds, or quantitative claims |
| Prompt Evaluation | `prompt-evaluation.md` | Comparing prompts, models, tools, or generation strategies fairly |
| Research Ethics | `research-ethics.md` | Reviewing research involving people, sensitive data, experiments, or harm |
| Research Methodology | `research-methodology.md` | Framing an investigation and producing a confidence-rated finding |
| Source Research | `source-research.md` | Finding, appraising, citing, and synthesizing external or documentary sources |

## Loading Order

For broad studies, start with `research-methodology.md`. Add
`evidence-gathering.md` or `source-research.md` for collection, then the
domain-specific method. Load `research-ethics.md` whenever people or sensitive data are
involved. Use `data-storytelling.md` only after analysis is complete.
